title: Extreme heat wave threatens U.S. power grids and July 4 travel
title_zh: 极端热浪威胁美国电网和7月4日旅行
text: The heat wave threatens to overwhelm U.S. grids and may force some to change their plans on one of the busiest travel weeks of the year.
zh: 热浪可能会淹没美国电网，并可能迫使一些人在一年中最繁忙的旅行周之一改变计划。

title: Job seekers giving up: Labor force participation rate falls to lowest in 50 years, outside of Covid era
title_zh: 求职者放弃：劳动力参与率降至Covid时代之外50年来的最低水平
text: A drop in the unemployment rate helped provide some upside to what was an otherwise downbeat jobs report — but it was for all the wrong reasons.
zh: 失业率的下降为原本悲观的就业报告带来了一些好处，但其原因却完全错误。

title: Oman walks a diplomatic tightrope over Strait of Hormuz fees, creating a ‘blind spot’ for markets
title_zh: 阿曼在霍尔木兹海峡收费问题上走外交钢丝，为市场创造了“盲点”
text: Oman is using strategic ambiguity as talks over possible Strait of Hormuz fees raise legal, diplomatic and oil market concerns.
zh: 由于有关可能的霍尔木兹海峡费用的谈判引发了法律、外交和石油市场的担忧，阿曼正在利用战略模糊性。

title: Sandwich chain Jersey Mike's files for IPO, reports 50% same-store sales growth in recent years
title_zh: 三明治连锁店 Jersey Mike 申请 IPO，报告近年来同店销售额增长 50%
text: Jersey Mike's has nearly 3,300 locations, making it the second-largest hoagie sandwich chain in the U.S. behind Subway.
zh: Jersey Mike's 拥有近 3,300 家门店，是仅次于 Subway 的美国第二大三明治连锁店。

title: Married Americans tend to be wealthier and happier. Gen Z is forgoing the institution anyway
title_zh: 已婚的美国人往往更富有、更幸福。无论如何，Z 世代正在放弃这个机构
text: Gen Z defines the American Dream as having financial stability and being happy. Marriage could help them reach both of those goals, but many aren't sold on it.
zh: Z 世代将美国梦定义为拥有财务稳定和幸福。婚姻可以帮助他们实现这两个目标，但许多人并不相信这一点。

title: Premier Lacrosse League plans to bring in team owners by 2028 'or soon thereafter,' co-founder says
title_zh: 联合创始人表示，英超长曲棍球联盟计划在 2028 年“或此后不久”引进球队老板
text: Paul Rabil told CNBC he's banking on the 2028 Los Angeles Summer Games, where lacrosse will return as an Olympic sport, to shine a spotlight on the PLL.
zh: 保罗·拉比尔 (Paul Rabil) 告诉 CNBC，他寄希望于 2028 年洛杉矶夏季奥运会，曲棍球将作为奥运会比赛项目回归，从而让 PLL 成为人们关注的焦点。

title: House lawmakers approved a bipartisan bill to protect older adults from financial fraud. Here's what to know
title_zh: 众议院议员批准了一项两党法案，以保护老年人免受财务欺诈。这是你需要知道的
text: The Financial Exploitation Prevention Act of 2025 is aimed at preventing adults age 65 or older or those with disabilities from losing their money to fraud.
zh: 2025 年《金融剥削预防法》旨在防止 65 岁或以上的成年人或残疾人因欺诈而损失金钱。

title: Global recession is inevitable if Strait of Hormuz stays shut, says Citadel's Ken Griffin
title_zh: Citadel 的 Ken Griffin 表示，如果霍尔木兹海峡继续关闭，全球经济衰退将不可避免
text: A prolonged blockage of the Strait of Hormuz for the next six to 12 months will mean an unavoidable recession, the billionaire investor said.
zh: 这位亿万富翁投资者表示，未来 6 到 12 个月霍尔木兹海峡的长期封锁将意味着不可避免的经济衰退。

title: Venezuela quake toll climbs to 2,595 as damage estimates mount after strongest tremor in a century
title_zh: 委内瑞拉地震死亡人数攀升至 2,595 人，损失估计在百年来最强烈的地震后增加
text: Death toll from twin earthquakes that struck Venezuela jumped to 2,595, as rescue operations continued after the country's strongest tremors in over a century.
zh: 委内瑞拉发生的两次地震造成的死亡人数跃升至 2,595 人，在该国遭受一个多世纪以来最强烈的地震后，救援行动仍在继续。

title: Kuaishou shares jump after Tencent joins $2.8 billion raise for Kling AI subsidiary
title_zh: 腾讯加入对 Kling AI 子公司 28 亿美元融资后，快手股价上涨
text: Kuaishou shares rose as much as 6.89% at Friday's Hong Kong market open before paring gains to trade around 0.75% higher.
zh: 周五香港市场开盘，快手股价一度上涨 6.89%，随后回吐涨幅，上涨约 0.75%。

title: Jack Smith says he's 'very concerned what's going to happen next election' under Trump
title_zh: 杰克·史密斯表示，他“非常担心特朗普领导下的下一次选举会发生什么”
text: Smith said that he could be indicted by the Department of Justice given Trump's animus toward him for prosecuting the president in two criminal cases.
zh: 史密斯表示，鉴于特朗普因在两起刑事案件中起诉总统而对他怀有敌意，他可能会被司法部起诉。

title: Tesla stock sinks 7% despite strong deliveries report, posting worst day in nearly a year
title_zh: 尽管交付报告强劲，特斯拉股价仍下跌 7%，创下近一年来最糟糕的一天
text: Tesla is trying to recover from consecutive annual declines in vehicle sales that were partly caused by a consumer backlash against CEO Elon Musk.
zh: 特斯拉正试图从汽车销量连续年度下滑的局面中恢复过来，部分原因是消费者对首席执行官埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)的强烈反对。

title: Rafael Nadal talks tennis prize money, his hotels, and what sports taught him about business
title_zh: 拉斐尔·纳达尔谈论网球奖金、他的酒店以及体育教会他的商业知识
text: Rafael Nadal opened his fourth Zel hotel as he expands into hospitality, education and sports after retiring from tennis.
zh: 拉斐尔·纳达尔 (Rafael Nadal) 从网球退役后将业务扩展到酒店、教育和体育领域，开设了他的第四家泽尔酒店 (Zel hotel)。

title: Led by Buc-ee’s and new rival Dolly Parton, America’s gas station chains are in a mega-sizing era
title_zh: 在 Buc-ee’s 和新竞争对手 Dolly Parton 的带领下，美国连锁加油站正处于大型时代
text: Gas station chains led by Buc-ee's are coming closer to rivaling America's big box stores in size, and Dolly Parton is getting in on the retail trend.
zh: 以 Buc-ee's 为首的连锁加油站在规模上已接近与美国大型卖场相媲美，而 Dolly Parton 也正在紧随零售潮流。

title: Microsoft commits $2.5 billion and 6,000 employees to new AI implementation unit
title_zh: 微软承诺为新的人工智能实施部门投入 25 亿美元和 6,000 名员工
text: Microsoft is the latest tech company to form a business focused on helping customers understand and implement artificial intelligence.
zh: 微软是最新一家专注于帮助客户理解和实施人工智能业务的科技公司。

title: Autonomous drone startup Quantum Systems raises $1.2 billion as investors pile into defense
title_zh: 投资者纷纷进军国防领域，自主无人机初创公司 Quantum Systems 融资 12 亿美元

zh: 大西洋两岸的国防科技初创公司在该领域的投资热潮中筹集了创纪录的资金。

title: Ford Q2 sales drop 10.3% due to F-Series supplier issue, falling EV demand
title_zh: 由于F系列供应商问题和电动汽车需求下降，福特第二季度销量下降10.3%
text: Ford said its EV sales fell by 40.7% during the quarter compared with a year earlier, while sales of its F-Series trucks, including the F-150, declined 11%.
zh: 福特表示，该季度电动汽车销量同比下降 40.7%，而包括 F-150 在内的 F 系列卡车销量下降 11%。

title: Treasury says Trump Account investment options will include State Street, BlackRock and Vanguard ETFs
title_zh: 财政部表示特朗普账户投资选择将包括道富银行、贝莱德和先锋 ETF

zh: 美国财政部表示，特朗普账户的投资阵容包括道富银行、贝莱德和先锋集团的 ETF。

zh: 很大一部分美国家庭没有投资股票，也没有从牛市中受益。

zh: 瑞银 (UBS) 的数据显示，2025 年全球个人财富飙升 10.8%，为 2017 年以来的最大增幅。

text: Ford reports it assembled over 2 million vehicles in the U.S. last year – more than any other auto manufacturer, including 311,000 units for export.
zh: 福特报告称，去年该公司在美国组装了超过 200 万辆汽车，超过任何其他汽车制造商，其中 311,000 辆用于出口。

title: Most prediction market contracts have low volume, leaving users exposed to volatility and bots

title_zh: 美国人正在为牛排支付创纪录的价格。这就是需求没有增长的原因
